title: Inventory European home-scene ROM reads
changes: Record a current-revision address-only inventory of a previously verified home continuation and retain attribution as open work.
validation: Wine e207-home-audit-wine-kkbk45be passes a 600-frame E202-d201 reference/managed pair with state, guest clock, video, OAM, dispatch and nonempty audio equality; protected inputs match, Wine drains and no Bluetooth D-Bus assertion appears.
The selected readers observe 97551 distinct ROM bytes, including 8544 outside the current source manifest; three sampled ranges near 3fb21c, 3fc3b0 and 3fd4f0 contain 6041 of those unowned bytes.
limitations: Address-only observations do not establish the executing PCs, authenticated source extents or data semantics. Other scenes and readers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending; no performance measurements were made.
